visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair styled in a braid and blunt bangs is standing in the middle of a densely crowded night market. She wears a black long-sleeved mesh top over a black tank top, paired with a grey pleated skirt and a dark belt. She is looking directly at the camera while eating a small, brownish snack from a wooden stick. In her left hand, she holds a white plastic bag and a white branded paper cup with a black straw. The background is bustling with pedestrians wearing casual attire, and various glowing shop signs are visible, including a prominent yellow sign and a white Birkenstock sign. (2) The camera remains handheld as the woman continues to interact with the viewer. She takes a sip from her drink through the straw and waves her hand toward the lens with a bright, cheerful smile. Her eyes squint slightly as she laughs. The street behind her is filled with warm artificial light from numerous food stalls and hanging lamps. People in the background are seen walking in both directions, some carrying bags and others looking at the surrounding stalls. The overall atmosphere is energetic and lively. (3) She reaches her left hand forward, extending a small white object toward the camera, possibly a napkin or a piece of paper. She maintains a playful and engaging expression. Her red leather shoulder bag is visible, featuring a small Duffy the Disney Bear plush keychain hanging from the strap. The background shows more storefronts, including one with a red sign and various product displays. (4) The woman is seen at a game stall playing ring toss. She holds a red plastic ring and prepares to toss it toward several rows of bottles and small prizes arranged on stepped shelves. The stall is brightly lit with overhead fluorescent lights. A man in a grey t-shirt and glasses is visible in the background, observing the activity. (5) She eats a piece of golden-fried food from a plastic bag while still holding her beverage. The shot then cuts to her sitting or standing at a counter, eating noodles with a spoon from a small white ceramic bowl. The lighting is bright and flat, characteristic of an indoor food stall. (6) She is seen playing a pinball-style game that uses mahjong tiles on a red table surface. She carefully pushes a blue tile into a slot. Following this, she is shown at a retail stall trying on different pairs of glasses. She first puts on oversized round glasses with red bows, then switches to a pair of black-rimmed rectangular glasses. A man wearing a grey cap stands close behind her, appearing to be part of her group or a vendor. (7) She takes a large bite of a piece of yellow durian fruit held in a plastic bag. Her expression changes from curiosity to surprise and then enjoyment as she looks at the camera. Signs for the 'Keelung Miaokou' and 'Aisi Road Night Market' are briefly visible in the background. The video ends with a close-up shot of her resting her face on her hands, smiling broadly at the camera.
